fichas.title: British Standards for building services
fichas.summary: Continuation of a reference list of British Standards covering water-based and electrical heating, heating-system energy calculations, ventilation-system inspection and testing, energy performance, and ground heat transfer.
uses: Reference standards for building-services design, installation, inspection, testing, and performance.

fichas.title: German Standards for building services
fichas.summary: Continuation of a reference list of DIN standards covering electrical room heating, heating and ventilation energy efficiency, ventilation symbols and terminology, thermal insulation and energy economy, and heat transfer via the ground.
uses: Reference standards for building-services terminology, heating, ventilation, and thermal performance.

fichas.title: British Standards for building physics and protection
fichas.summary: Reference list of British Standards for waterproofing and workmanship, timber preservation, joint fillers and sealants, glazing, building and room acoustics, electrical-equipment safety marking, fire testing and classification, fire and smoke control, fire-service equipment, and thermal performance of building elements and envelopes.
uses: Reference standards for building protection, acoustics, fire safety, and thermal performance.

fichas.title: German Standards for building physics and protection
fichas.summary: Reference list of DIN standards for waterproofing, timber protection, joint and glazing sealants, sound insulation and building acoustics, safety marking, fire behaviour and classification, fire barriers, smoke and heat control, fire-service access and escape provisions, and thermal performance and air permeability.
uses: Reference standards for building protection, acoustics, fire safety, and thermal performance.
